scripts.build:shared: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w packages/shared-ownership-dvm
scripts.build:notifications: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w packages/notifications-dvm
scripts.build:profiles: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w packages/profiles-dvm
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:happ -w example/webapp && npm run build:happ:clone -w example/webapp && bash scripts/ts-bindings-example.sh
scripts.build:cell: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w packages/cell-proxy
scripts.build:libs: npm run build:cell && npm run build -w packages/lit-happ && npm run build -w packages/we-utils && npm run build:profiles && npm run build:notifications && npm run build:shared
scripts.devtest: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:happ && bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build:libs && npm run start
scripts.devtest:clone: npm run build:happ && npm run build:libs && npm run build -w example/webapp && npm run start:clone
scripts.devtest:we: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:happ && bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run start:we
scripts.dist:we: npm run dist -w we-applet && npm run package:we
scripts.package:we: rm -rf artifacts/playground-we_applet-ui.zip & cd example/we-applet/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../../artifacts/playground-we_applet-ui.zip * && cd ../../../ && hc web-app pack example/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/playground-we_applet.webhapp
scripts.prodtest:we: cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:run" "cross-env AGENT_NUM=1 npm run prodtest:we-launch"
scripts.prodtestfull:we: npm run dist -w example/webapp && npm run dist -w we-applet && npm run prodtest:we
scripts.serve: cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) SIGNAL_PORT=$(cat .hc_signalenv) npm run serve:run
scripts.publish:cell: npm run build:cell && cd packages/cell-proxy && npm publish
scripts.publish:lit: npm run build -w packages/lit-happ && cd packages/lit-happ && npm publish
scripts.publish:we: npm run build -w packages/we-utils && cd packages/we-utils && npm publish
scripts.publish:profiles: npm run build -w packages/profiles-dvm && cd packages/profiles-dvm && npm publish
scripts.publish:notifications: npm run build -w packages/notifications-dvm && cd packages/notifications-dvm && npm publish
scripts.publish:shared: npm run build -w packages/shared-ownership-dvm && cd packages/shared-ownership-dvm && npm publish
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:cell && npm run publish:lit && npm run publish:we && npm run publish:profiles && npm run publish:notifications && npm run publish:shared
